horses.incident_text: On jumping was crowded between COLOURFUL BARON and SUPER HONG KONG.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Shortly after the start made contact with CHATEAU LE PECHE due to both runners shifting ground.  Sent for sampling post-race.
No report.

Shifted in abruptly at the start and was bumped.  When questioned Z Purton stated that the intention was to endeavour to hold an on-pace position, preferably with cover.  He said after commencing well he was able to settle in a handy position in the early stages but when HAKKA RADIANCE continued forward to race outside the lead STORM RUNNER was obliged to race wide and without cover for the majority of the event.  When questioned regarding his vigour in the Home Straight, particularly between the 300 Metres and the 200 Metres Z Purton stated that when YEABOI shifted out this resulted in STORM RUNNER wanting to lay out and away from that horse which then restricted his ability to ride his mount with full vigour at that point as his focus was on keeping STORM RUNNER balanced.  He added that STORM RUNNER continued to respond to his urgings to the finish of the event and, in his opinion, is looking for additional distance in its races.  Trainer P C Ng confirmed the instructions issued.
Shortly after the start made contact with YEABOI due to both runners shifting ground.
No report.

After the event A Badel stated that his mount was slow to begin and settled at the rear of the field.  He said in the Home Straight MR ALADDIN found it difficult to make up ground from that position.  A Badel was reprimanded in relation to using his whip in a manner where the hand holding the whip was above shoulder height on four occasions in the Home Straight. A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  Sent for sampling post-race.
No report.

Jumped only fairly and then was crowded by STORM RUNNER which shifted in abruptly.  After the event K Teetan stated that his mount did not appreciate the "Yielding” track conditions.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
In the early and middle stages raced keenly.
Sent for sampling post-race.

Jumped only fairly.  Over the concluding stages lay in, resulting in its rider M F Poon having to direct his mount to the outside of MOTOR approaching the winning post to continue into clear running.  Sent for sampling post-race.

In the early stages raced keenly and near the 1000 Metres got its head up when being eased to allow MOTOR to cross.  Making the turn after the 900 Metres became unbalanced when racing to the inside of FALCON HUNTER.
Jumped only fairly.  From a wide barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
Jumped awkwardly and then shortly after the start raced tight between MOTOR and FALCON HUNTER which shifted in slightly.

When questioned Z Purton stated that his mount travelled comfortably in the lead in the early stages although throughout the event made a respiratory noise.  He added that when asked for an effort in the Home Straight FIELD MARSHAL responded only fairly to his urgings.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race found that horse to be displaying an airway abnormality pending further assessment.  Sent for sampling post-race. <19/10/2025 21 September 2025 Sha Tin Racemeeting– Race 2 (38)> A further assessment of the airway abnormality did not reveal any significant findings.

After the event K Teetan stated that his mount was obliged to race wide and without cover for the majority of the event.  He added that the horse also raced greenly during the running of the race and may not have appreciated the "Yielding” track conditions.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race found that horse to be a "roarer”.
Jumped awkwardly, resulting in its rider L Ferraris becoming unbalanced.
No report.
No report.
No report.
Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.  Sent for sampling post-race.

After the event J Orman confirmed that the intention was to hold a more forward position.  He said when caught wide in the early stages he was obliged to settle further back in an attempt to find cover.  Sent for sampling post-race.
No report.
No report.

Near the 900 Metres, PERIDOT, which was racing keenly, got its head up when being steadied to avoid FLASH STAR (R Kingscote) which shifted in when not clear.  As a result PERIDOT then shifted out, resulting in ELEGANT LIFE, which was following, having to steady to avoid PERIDOT and ELEGANT LIFE then shifting out.  As a result BASIC INSTINCT was crowded and NOBLE FANS steadied when EMBLAZON (C L Chau) shifted in.  R Kingscote was severely reprimanded and advised he must ensure he is sufficiently clear when shifting ground.  C L Chau was reprimanded for shifting in and contributing to the interference to NOBLE FANS and BASIC INSTINCT.  After the event Z Purton could offer no explanation for his mount’s failure to finish the race off in the Home Straight.  Sent for sampling post-race.

Near the 900 Metres was steadied to avoid PERIDOT.  When questioned regarding his riding in the Home Straight L Hewitson stated that after following PERIDOT he initially contemplated improving between PERIDOT and FLASH STAR leaving the 400 Metres.  He added that when he was not comfortable there was sufficient room to improve between those two runners he shifted out to follow PERIDOT as he felt that runner, which was a favourite in the event, would provide him with the opportunity to follow it into the race.  He said when PERIDOT did not improve as he had expected and AWESOME TREASURE maintained its position to that runner’s outside this resulted in ELEGANT LIFE being badly held up for clear running over the final 400 Metres and not being able to be ridden out to the finish.  Having considered Jockey Hewitson’s explanation and whilst he agreed that a run had developed between FLASH STAR and PERIDOT, the Stewards found that the explanation provided was reasonable in the circumstances.

Between the 150 Metres and the 50 Metres was held up for clear running behind PERIDOT.  After being shifted to the inside of PERIDOT near the 50 Metres then could not be fully ridden out when it raced tight to the inside of that runner.  After the event C Y Ho reported that his mount jumped only fairly and did not show sufficient pace in the early stages to hold a more forward position.

On jumping made contact with the left side of its starting gate and lost ground.  Despite being ridden along in the early stages failed to show sufficient pace to hold a more forward position and became detached from the field. A Atzeni was reprimanded in relation to using his whip in a manner where the hand holding the whip was above shoulder height on one occasion near the 200 Metres.

After the event R Kingscote stated that it was not the intention to lead.  He said when his mount commenced well and other runners in the event did not show the intent to lead he continued forward to lead to avoid racing wide.
Jumped only fairly.  Between the 400 Metres and the 300 Metres had difficulty obtaining clear running.

Near the 900 Metres was steadied when crowded.  After the event B Avdulla stated that after being steadied near the 900 Metres his mount finished the race off only fairly and may not have appreciated the "Yielding” track conditions.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race which included an endoscopic examination showed a substantial amount of blood in the horse’s trachea.  Before being allowed to race again, NOBLE FANS will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
Near the 900 Metres was crowded.
Sent for sampling post-race.
Sent for sampling post-race.

After the race an endoscopic examination was conducted on ALLCASH at the request of Trainer C S Shum.  The Veterinary Surgeon said this examination showed a substantial amount of blood in the horse’s trachea.  Before being allowed to race again, ALLCASH will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Jumped only fairly.
No report.
Making the Home Turn raced tight to the inside of GLORIOUS JOURNEY.
H Bentley was reprimanded for using the whip on consecutive occasions in 2 consecutive strides near the 300 Metres.

Jumped only fairly and then was crowded by ALLCASH which shifted out slightly.  When questioned A Atzeni stated that entering the Back Straight he allowed SUPER UNICORN to improve between KASA PAPA and ALLCASH as he had expected KASA PAPA to shift to the fence.  He said when KASA PAPA remained racing one-off SUPER UNICORN, which was travelling only fairly at the time, was crowded by ALLCASH which was positioned tight to the inside of FASHION LEGEND (R Kingscote).  R Kingscote was advised to exercise more care.

Jumped only fairly.  After the event Y L Chung stated that his intention was to endeavour to come to the outside to make his run in the Home Straight.  He said when unable to do so LESLIE finished the race off only fairly in the Home Straight.
A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

After the event R Kingscote stated that his mount was obliged to race wide during the running of the race although it was able to obtain cover.  He said given the wide run the horse endured it could not finish the race off in the Home Straight.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.
Raced very wide and without cover for the majority of the event.
Sent for sampling post-race.
Shifted out at the start and was bumped.  Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.  Sent for sampling post-race.
No report.
No report.
Slow to begin.  Between the 400 Metres and the 300 Metres was held up for clear running.
No report.

Jumped only fairly.  From a wide barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.  When questioned J Orman stated that from a wide barrier he rode his mount in a conservative manner in the early stages as instructed.  He said making the Home Turn due to the heavy rain he lowered his goggles which provided him with better visibility after the 400 Metres.  He added that approaching the 200 Metres when positioned close to NEWBORN MIRACLE he shifted to that runner’s inside but again his visibility was restricted when positioned behind BEAUTY VIVA and as a consequence he could not ride his mount with his usual vigour over the final 200 Metres.
No report.
No report.

Jumped awkwardly.  Raced keenly when positioned outside the lead in the early and middle stages.  After the event C Y Ho stated that his mount, in his opinion, did not run out a strong 1600 Metres.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
No report.
Raced very wide and without cover for the majority of the event.

Shortly after the start was crowded by HAPPY UNIVERSE which shifted in and away from NEWBORN MIRACLE.  When questioned regarding the disappointing performance of STAR BROSE Z Purton stated that, in his opinion, the horse’s barrier trial leading into the race had been only fair.  He added that STAR BROSE travelled satisfactorily through the run but failed to respond to his riding in the Home Straight and he could offer no explanation for the disappointing performance.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  Sent for sampling post-race.

Bumped at the start.  After the event K De Melo stated that his mount was disadvantaged by having to carry 134 lbs on the "Soft” track conditions and as a consequence did not run on in the Home Straight.   A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
Bumped at the start.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Jumped only fairly.  Sent for sampling post-race.
No report.
Sent for sampling post-race.

Bumped on jumping and as a result shifted in. A Badel was warned in relation to using his whip in a manner where the hand holding the whip was above shoulder height on two occasions near the 150 Metres.
Bumped at the start.

After the event K C Leung reported that his mount jumped awkwardly and then was checked when crowded by THE RED HARE which shifted in.  He said as a consequence FLYING KNIGHT settled back in the field and did not appreciate the kickback that it received on the "soft” track.

Jumped awkwardly, shifted in and made contact with THE RED HARE.  Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event. A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
No report.

Bumped by another horse whilst parading behind the barriers.  Was examined by the Veterinary Officer and passed suitable to race.  After the event C Y Ho reported that his mount raced too keenly outside the lead before giving ground in the Home Straight.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race which included an endoscopic examination showed a substantial amount of blood in the horse’s trachea.  Before being allowed to race again, STANLEY EXPRESS will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
No report.

The performance of FIVEFORTWO, which finished tailed out on the second consecutive occasion, was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, FIVEFORTWO will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in consecutive barrier trials and be subjected to an official veterinary examination which must include additional diagnostic assessments.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
From a wide barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Near the 600 Metres blundered on the "soft” track and became unbalanced.  Sent for sampling post-race.
No report.
No report.

Jumped awkwardly and then shortly after the start was crowded between RATTAN GALAXY and BULL ATTITUDE which shifted in.  Despite being ridden along after this incident BEAUTY GLORY was unable to hold a more forward position.  Briefly held up for clear running near the 350 Metres when SUPERB GUY commenced to give ground.  Sent for sampling post-race.

Between the 300 Metres and the 200 Metres had difficulty obtaining clear running.  After improving to the inside of SUPERB GUY near the 200 Metres then shifted in and away from that runner and made contact with RATTAN GALAXY.
Blundered near the 600 Metres.  Near the 400 Metres was steadied when disappointed for clear running between SOLID WIN and BLING BLING GENIUS which shifted out slightly to improve.
Shifted out at the start and was bumped.
No report.
Briefly held up approaching the 350 Metres before shifting to the outside of BULL ATTITUDE to obtain clear running.

After the event L Hewitson stated that he was obliged to make some use of his mount in the early stages to cross runners which resulted in the horse setting a strong pace in the early stages.  He added that, in his opinion, BULL ATTITUDE was not suited by being ridden in this manner and may perform better when being ridden in a more conservative manner.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

Jumped only fairly.  Between the 400 Metres and the 300 Metres had difficulty obtaining clear running.  Then again between the 200 Metres and the 50 Metres was badly held up for clear running behind DIRIYA which was giving ground.

Shortly after the start was crowded between INNO SUPER and SUPERB GUY which shifted out at the start.  Near the 350 Metres was bumped and taken wider by DIRIYA which shifted out to improve.  Approaching the 150 Metres became unbalanced when crowded between RATTAN GALAXY and ALL ROUND WINNER.

Bumped on jumping by FIGHTING MACHINE which shifted out.  A short distance later RATTAN GALAXY then raced in restricted room to the inside of BEAUTY GLORY which was taken in by BULL ATTITUDE before it was straightened by its rider.  When giving ground approaching the 150 Metres was steadied when crowded between FIGHTING MACHINE which shifted in and away from SUPERB GUY and SEA CHARIOT which was taken out by ALL ROUND WINNER when that runner shifted out when being steadied to avoid DIRIYA.  Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

Shifted out at the start, was bumped and became unbalanced.  Approaching the 1500 Metres was steadied when racing tight to the inside of NEVER PETER OUT when that runner was momentarily crowded by YOUNG BRILLIANT which shifted in as it was being corrected by its rider K De Melo.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Jumped only fairly and was then shifted across behind runners in the early stages.  Sent for sampling post-race.
No report.
Jumped only fairly and then was crowded between MOJAVE DESERT and NEVER PETER OUT, both of which shifted ground.
Held up for clear running between the 350 Metres and the 250 Metres.
No report.

Approaching the first turn near the 1500 Metres was checked when tightened for room between YOUNG BRILLIANT which was endeavouring to hold its position three horses off the fence and CHILL KAKA which shifted in and away from NEW FOREST (L Hewitson) despite the efforts of its rider Z Purton.  L Hewitson was advised that due to some contributing factors no direct action was taken but he should exercise more care in similar circumstances.  Lay out making the Home Turn.

After the event Apprentice P N Wong stated that her mount did not show sufficient pace to hold a forward position.  She said when caught very wide in the early and middle stages her mount was under pressure as she endeavoured to go forward to cross runners to her inside.  She said when unable to cross, ARIEL was obliged to race wide and without cover for the majority of the event before failing to run on in the Home Straight.

Shifted in at the start and was bumped.  Tightened for room inside of YOUNG BRILLIANT approaching the first turn near the 1500 Metres.  After the event M L Yeung reported that his mount did not appreciate the "Wet Slow” track conditions.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

After the event Z Purton stated that his mount was able to obtain a position outside the lead but travelled a little keenly in the early stages.  He said when placed under pressure in the Home Straight his mount failed to respond and was disappointing.  He added that, in his opinion, the horse may be better suited when ridden in a more conservative manner in the early stages.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

The performance of KINGDOM OF RICHES, which finished tailed out, was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, KINGDOM OF RICHES will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.   A veterinary inspection immediately following the race which included an endoscopic examination showed a substantial amount of blood in the horse’s trachea.
